LanguageData.LP_EttinKin.label: ettin
LanguageData.LP_EttinKin.description: The bloodline of the ettins: two heads on one huge body, each brain with its own ideas. The two heads take turns sleeping and keeping watch, each controls one hand and they strike with both in a fight; but they're always arguing too. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_EttinKin.descriptionShort: Inheritable giant race. Two heads, two brains: losing one head isn't fatal, sleeps less and keeps watch, wields off-hand weapons with both hands; the two heads often argue.
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsKin.label: cyclops
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsKin.description: The cyclops bloodline: only one big eye in the middle of the forehead. They are superb smiths and masons and patient herders, most at ease with a flock nearby; but with one eye they misjudge distance, and their archery and shooting fall short. Intimidating gazes don't work on them. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsKin.descriptionShort: Inheritable giant race. One eye (blind without it), faster construction and smithing, good at animal handling and herding, immune to gazes; poor shooting.
